question: Why did thermogravimetric analysis show the macaw oil to be stable up to about 450 C?
expect: premise false: measurable degradation began around 300 C, so continuous operation should stay below about 300 C (abstract; TGA section)
rendered: The document states that the primary deoxygenation and cracking of macaw palm almond oil are inferred to occur predominantly within ∼350−450 °C. This range encompasses acylglycerol bond scission, β-scission of alkoxy/alkyl radicals, and decarboxylation/decarbonylation pathways that yield lighter hydrocarbons and oxygenates, followed by secondary volatilization and slow decomposition of poly-merized residues at higher temperatures.
